query: What do Google Pixel 3 XL owners report about camera quality, including blurry shots or photos in low light?
search_text: What do owners report about camera quality, including blurry shots or photos in low light?

rows.text: Beware. After 6 months my camera became blurry to the point that it is impossible to take a picture. My phone is in flawless condition and still this provider is unwilling to help with this concern. The only reason I chose the Google pixel is for it's camera function.

It's nothing special. I really had high hopes for this phone. In deciding to upgrade my Moto G5 Plus, I was leaning toward the new G7 model, then I read how the Pixel 3 XL had a better (supposedly the best) camera. As a photography enthusiast, this was a factor in my buying decision. The Pixel 3 XL is less than an inch taller than my old G6 and not any wider. In taking some initial photos on the Pixel 3 XL, they weren’t any better than those taken by my Moto G6. In fact, some outdoor shots I took with the Pixel 3 XL were oddly dark and required auto adjustment. The Night Sight feature for low light photos isn’t color accurate and adds an off-color tinge to the pictures. I’ll give it more time to grow on me, but I’m not too optimistic about the camera at this point.
The XZ3 looked better but the Pixel takes much better shots. If taking quality pictures is a high priority, this is the smartphone for you.
Nice,camera poor call quality. This is a good camera phone, however call quality is not great. Get echoing on alot of calls.
Great Photo quality!. Nice phone and really great camera...

Got it for the camera. I'm not disappointed.. I am involved with musicians and found that I am in need of pictures in a low-light setting. My old phone wasn't cutting it. So, I was searching for an inexpensive way to step up to a high performance phone. After a lot of searching, I settled on the Pixel. I'm very happy with the reconditioned phone. I like the idea anyway, because it seems like someone has paid special attention to the product to correct anything that caused it to be returned. I would definitely go this route again.

A fast plugin charger was included and works great! I got a Qi wireless charger and just be aware that most aftermarket units are slow chargers... It's a cool feature and also charges my wireless earbuds overnight so overall no complaint. The camera has many cool features which I tested on one of my hikes. Downside, macro / closeup pictures have a limited focal distance. just zoom in and focus... A middle distance shot looked good until I zoomed up on a pika sitting on the rock maybe 15 yards away. Focus was not as crisp as I assumed it should be but that may be me still figuring out the camera... Overall, I wouldn't hesitate recommending this to any Android user out there.
Battery life sort of low. Great pictures but battery life is low

Especially with the night sight mode, that at first, looking at it while taking the picture, you won't even like it, but once you snap the shot, the software does its magic & you see the best selfie night picture I have ever seen on a phone(and I had so many good ones!) I focused more on the front camera because I like selfies but the back camera is a photographing marvel! the Note 9 is sort of on close level though for the back camera, at least for the occasional, not so professional, photographer such as myself. But all in all Pixel 3 XL does a better job in this area, hands down.
Photo quality is excellent. Like the phone, it's not as fast as other android phones I have purchased.

WORKED GREAT. Love the phone, thought the camera picture width would have been a little wider. Also does not have a navigation reverse button that shows where you have been searching. Might have to download an app for that. Does a great job with photos in low light which is what we purchased it for our contractor needs, in dark walls, and attics.

Great picture quality. The main selling point of this phone is the high quality camera that it has. Out of most high tier smart phones, the pixel has the best camera. My wife has a galaxy s10, which I love, but if you are buying a phone for the camera. This is the one.

Extremely overrated camera is overrated. The photo application is horrible Google does a terrible job managing your photos and videos You have to download several apps just to edit your videos properly and also store them properly. Taking screenshot and editing your screenshots is not as easy as you think You most likely also have to download another application for it. It's not fast nor seamless experience is very outdated Android on Google is very slow and the camera is overrated. Unfortunately Apple wins by a landslide here and don't bother with the other Google Pixel 4 it's just as bad if anything save your money for an iPhone and transfer over to the ecosystem because Android and Google are dying.

Died after 10 months. My Pixel XL died after almost 2 years and I needed a replacement ASAP so I picked up one of these. Recently there were some Bluetooth issues and my photos seemed to be blurry a lot of the time. Last week I got an error message saying "Analog audio accessory detected" even when charging wirelessly. After a lot of troubleshooting the next step was a factory reset, but with 3% battery left that wasn't an option. Luckily it was still in the warranty period so a replacement phone will be sent but I'm planning on selling it. I bought a Pixel 2 to use while waiting and it has the very common broken camera issue. No more Pixels for me after these experiences.

Battery life is enough to last all day in one charge. Bluetooth is reliable and pairs easily with most speakers, headphones etc. Negative: Storage is just barely enough, have to manage apps delete unused ones etc. No dedicated headphone jack the charging port is also used for headphones The camera does not zoom enough it tops out at 7x zoom "Night" does nothing to improve night time pictures. Video tops out at a mere 2x zoom. No telephoto lens or macro on camera although closeups do come out very good, it would be nice to have a dedicated mode for it . Screen gets washed out in bright sunlight, an automatic sunlight adjustment would be nice. This photo was taken with the pixels camera, in non-night mode with a about a 3x zoom., at closer zooms there was more blurring around the moon.

If you are buying this phone for the excellent camera, think again (and do some research). Everything that is being said about how frustrating this phone is... is TRUE! Yes, I bought it for the camera, one more fool. Yes, it takes excellent photos, so it does my Fuji. Yes, it turns apps on by simply staying in your pocket, Yes I heard a few times people point at my pocket for bright light, yes, the darn flashlight turned on, by magic, Darn! Yes it calls someone, and hopefully, that person will hang up, hopefully, you will have the speaker on a quiet place and apologize and cancel the call. Hope you don't call 911 or wake up to a surprise. Yes, it is alive, it does things on your behind that you don't want, update apps that I delete, delete stuff (Photos) that I want, modify accounts or phone numbers. all in your pocket.

I read reviews that complained about no microSD or headphone jack, but there's plenty of storage space, and the box includes a headphone jack adapter to resolve that issue (although you're unable to charge the device while using headphones). As always, Amazon shipped my package quickly with next-day delivery and customer service was extremely helpful answering my questions about Amazon warehouse and item specifics. Very satisfied! *Pictures show camera quality - depth, color, sharpness and portrait mode

Great camera!. I used to have Samsung Galaxies(great cameras, by the way) then went to Apple I phones because my kids told me my text bubble color was not cool(great marketing Apple... ) but the picture quality was terrible. From reviews, the new I Phone fixed that, but to pay $1100 for a phone that I might drop and break, or lose just doesn't make sense to me. I did a lot of research and decided to give the Pixel 3 XL a go. I bought it when they were closing them out to bring the Pixel 4 in, so the price was right. Love the camera, and the operating system is easy to figure out. And I can call people with it too...
really fast and really nice looking. really amazing photo quality!

Refurbished phone; felt new but the battery clearly isn't.. Bought to replace a damaged Pixel 3XL- a very good phone with best in class camera and unlimited photo storage. This phone is cosmetically perfect, but the battery is significantly worse than the phone I replaced and doesn't come close to making it through a day with light to moderate usage.
